thread:
incidents-bot: 🚨 ROUTING ALERT: Elevated 5xx and decodes observed for text-gen requests. Suspected: variant mismatch during multi-region fallback + missing routing metadata. Pager triggered to oncall. Runbook: https://runbook.redwood/routing
Nia SRE: oncall here. seeing ~18% error rate spike starting 2026-03-20T11:12Z. Which policy change preceded this? any rollouts in last hour?
Liam Eng: we rotated variant weights at 11:05 (policy shuffle id: shuffle-2026-03-20-1105). The shuffle relaxed affinity for "primary-variant" to allow warm-up on smaller quantized variants. i'm rolling that change back.
Kat (Product): customers? impact severity?
Nia SRE: quick summary: several sessions from EU customers dropped into us-east-1 and were served by `edge-quant-v2` which fails tokenization for certain prompt framings -> 500/decoder_error. Decision logs for many of those requests show no route_tag or variant_reason field. sample:
```
[2026-03-20T11:14:03Z] decision_id=dec_73b route_policy=smart-fallback -> region=us-east-1 variant=edge-quant-v2 tags=[]
[2026-03-20T11:14:04Z] request=req_xzy status=500 "decoder_invalid_token"
```
Liam Eng: ack. I see logs where route metadata is dropped when the router hits the async fallback cache path. probable race in decision enrichment. reverting shuffle now.
OpsBot: rollback initiated: policy-shuffle shuffle-2026-03-20-1105 -> reverting to baseline config.
Nia SRE: applying emergency soft-pin for affected customers to keep them on eu variant while we investigate.
Nia SRE: CMD:
```
redwoodctl routing override create --policy smart-fallback --scope customer:enterprise-77 --region eu-west-1 --variant redwood-base --ttl 1h --reason "emergency pin — fallback anomalies"
```
Nia SRE: override accepted. traffic rebalanced in ~22s. error rate for enterprise-77 dropped ~80%.
Kat (Product): Support notes: one enterprise account reported intermittent incorrect completions; severity P1. support thread open. i'll prepare a short customer update.
Liam Eng: investigating codepath: when fallback is satisfied from async cached candidates the enrichRouteMetadata() callback isn't awaited which leads to empty tags on decision log emission. easy fix: await enrichment or emit synthetic route_tag with fallback_reason.
Nia SRE: can we temporarily copy decision_id into request logs to help correlating while we patch?
Liam Eng: yes, pushing a logging shim now.
Liam Eng: SHIM:
```
redwoodctl deploy-config set router.eu-west-1 LOG_DECISION_TO_REQUEST=true
```
Nia SRE: shim in place. will help trace for postmortem.
OpsBot: policy rollback completed. monitoring.
Nia SRE: still seeing ~5% residual errors due to in-flight requests and CDN cached routing headers. expected to decay.
Kat (Product): drafting customer message: "We observed routing fallback-related errors causing intermittent 5xxs for some customers. Temporary mitigations applied (override + rollback). Engineers are working on a patch to restore routing metadata and prevent incorrect variant selection. We'll follow up after stabilization." Will send in 15m.
Liam Eng: plan: 1) push canary that ensures route_tag emission on fallback branch (simple await + fallback_reason), 2) add unit+integration test that simulates async fallback candidate flow asserting route_tag present, 3) monitor canary for 30m then roll forward. ETA ~45-70m.
Nia SRE: creating incident ticket RW-INC-2026-4 and assigning to routing-team + SRE. Link: https://tickets.redwood/RW-INC-2026-4
oncall-next: handoff note in 20m: rollback done, emergency override active, logging shim enabled, canary pending. will keep watch on alerts and customer escalations.
Nia SRE: action items (short): enforce route metadata on all decision paths, add fallback path tests, add canary gating for policy shuffles, customer comms. full postmortem once stable.
incidents-bot: UPDATE: mitigations active (override + rollback + logging shim). Status: stabilizing -> monitoring. Next update or on major change."
